name: Citizenship by Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: Four years of regular residence in Jordan (Nationality Law No. 6 of 1954, as amended, Article 12); the Council of Ministers may waive this requirement for Arabs or where naturalisation serves the public interest.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 4 years of regular residence in Jordan.

requirements.blocker_text: Good conduct and no prior criminal convictions (Article 4).
Demonstrated intent to reside in Jordan (Article 12).
Council of Ministers approval is required to grant naturalisation.

sources.title: Refworld (UNHCR) -- Jordan Nationality Law No. 6 of 1954, as amended to 1987: Article 12 (4 years' residence for naturalisation, waivable by Council of Ministers for Arabs or public interest), Article 4 (good conduct, lawful livelihood), Article 15/16/17 (renunciation and dual citizenship)

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jordan). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to Refworld's hosted English translation of Law No. 6 of 1954 (tier-2: UNHCR/intergovernmental publisher of the text, not Jordan's own gazette or Legislation and Opinion Bureau database, which could not be reached directly in this pass) rather than a tier-1 government publication of the amended law text. No explicit language requirement was found in the fetched text, unusual relative to most naturalisation regimes in this dataset -- disclosed as an absence rather than assumed. dual_citizenship_allowed is left NULL rather than inferred: Article 17 addresses the reverse direction only (an existing Jordanian who acquires a foreign nationality retains Jordanian nationality unless formally renounced) -- it says nothing about whether a foreigner naturalising AS Jordanian must first renounce their original nationality, and no procedural source describing that specific requirement was found in this pass. Flagged rather than guessed.
